messages:
Maya Patel: Quick check — we need to finalize the internal-link heatmap and anchor-text standards before the product launch next week. Who can own the page prioritization?
Sam Ortiz: I can take the prioritization list. I'll start with blog posts + docs pages that get referral traffic.
Priya Rao: I'll run an anchor-text sweep and flag inconsistent anchors. Will use the existing keywords sheet and add a column for intent.
Liam Chen: Can we also standardize canonical tags across localized pages? Last deploy left some mismatch (en vs global).
Maya Patel: Yes — canonical standardization is in scope. Sam, please add a column in the sheet for "canonical check" and mark pages that need redirects.
Sam Ortiz: Added the sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1aBcDEf-SEO-heatmap (pls comment). I'll tag the top 40 pages first.
Priya Rao: For anchor text rules, proposal: prefer 3 patterns — product-name, action + product (e.g., "try Redwood inference"), and keyword + intent. Anything more is noisy. Thoughts?
Liam Chen: Agree. Also avoid exact-match anchors for high-competition keywords on low-value pages. Use supporting anchors instead.
Maya Patel: Good call. Ana (SEO-bot), can you run a quick report for orphan pages and internalPageRank so we know where to inject anchors?
Ana (SEO-bot): Quick report ready — orphan pages: 12, high-keystone pages missing inbound internal links: 6. Uploading CSV to the sheet now.
Priya Rao: For redirects, I'll prepare a lightweight 301 plan. Sample rule to roll through infra (nginx):
```
# redirect old webinar landing
location = /rdw-webinar-2023 {
  return 301 https://www.redwood.inference/launch/webinar-2025;
}
```
Maya Patel: Perfect. Sam — prioritize webinar + benchmark posts for updated schema (FAQ, event schema) and ensure structured data is present before social goes live.
Sam Ortiz: Will do. I'll also add the JSON-LD snippets to the CMS draft. Quick checklist in sheet: [schema, anchors, canonical, redirects, follow-up owner].
Liam Chen: Timeline check — I can have the canonical fixes + small redirect list into staging by EOD tomorrow. After that we can run Lighthouse and schema validation.
Maya Patel: OK let's aim for staging review tomorrow morning. If no blockers, deploy the canonical/redirect batch Wed AM. Priya — ping me when the redirect list is final so infra can queue the rollout. :rocket:
Priya Rao: Will ping when ready. Estimating redirect list final by 17:00 PT tomorrow.
Ana (SEO-bot): Reminder set: staging-ci job will run schema-check and link-check at 07:00 UTC tomorrow.
Sam Ortiz: Adding launch-post slugs to the sheet now, cc @Maya.
Maya Patel: Thanks team — small, focused steps. We'll reconvene after the staging run and prioritize any regressions. :thumbsup:
